summary: Describes SPAKE2+, an augmented password-authenticated key exchange where only one party knows the password itself. This helps when a server should not hold the actual password. It was produced outside the IETF and IRTF and reflects the authors' opinions.

eli5.summary: Like SPAKE2, but only one side keeps the real password, so a thief breaking into the other side cannot just steal it.

questions: how to do key exchange from a password
